instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Orbit Networks is a municipal government administration serving a population of 250,000 residents with services spanning urban planning, waste management, social services, and cultural programming. We focus heavily on integrating emerging technologies to improve operational efficiency, such as optimizing resource allocation for infrastructure maintenance and enhancing citizen engagement through digital platforms.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: A major international competitor has signaled intent to enter our core market within the next 12 months. We have a 6-9 month window to build competitive moats through proprietary data sets and service-level improvements that would be costly for a new entrant to replicate quickly.
answers.additionalContext: Current operational bottlenecks often stem from siloed legacy systems and a lack of standardized data formats across departments, which hinders the ability to quickly pivot or scale new initiatives.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Predictive Infrastructure Maintenance Platform
opportunities.rationale: Implementing machine learning on existing sensor data (e.g., traffic flow or waste levels) to predict equipment failure allows for proactive scheduling rather than reactive repairs, directly enhancing service delivery and operational efficiency.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study on integrating existing IoT sensor data streams with a basic predictive model.
Identify the top three most failure-prone assets (e.g., specific traffic lights or waste routes) for pilot testing.
resources_needed: Minor software licenses for analytics tools
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in unplanned maintenance incidents by 15% within the pilot quarter.
milestones: Q3: Data pipeline established and initial model training complete.
Q4: Pilot deployment on one critical asset.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Citizen Inquiry Automation
opportunities.rationale: Develop a low-risk AI chatbot for handling high-volume, repetitive citizen inquiries (e.g., permit status, trash schedules), freeing up staff time and improving the perceived quality of public service interaction.

first_actions: Define top 20 most common citizen queries and map them to existing knowledge base documents.
Select a low-code AI platform (e.g., Azure Bot Service or similar) for MVP development.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in staff tickets/calls related to routine inquiries by 25%.
milestones: Q3: MVP launched and tested with internal users.
Q4: Full integration into the citizen services portal.

opportunities.title: Municipal Data Exchange & Insight Marketplace (Moat Building)
opportunities.rationale: Create a secure, anonymized data exchange platform that aggregates operational data across siloed departments. This turns internal operational metrics into unique strategic assets, creating a significant barrier to entry for competitors who rely on generic public-facing apps.

first_actions: Establish a cross-departmental steering committee focused solely on data governance and standardization.
Develop a comprehensive technical roadmap defining API requirements for secure internal data access.
resources_needed: Legal consultation for data privacy frameworks
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful onboarding of three departments to the secure data exchange platform within 12 months.
milestones: Q3: Platform architecture finalized and core governance rules approved.
Q4: Pilot integration between Urban Planning and Waste Management databases.

next_steps.action: Initiate the feasibility study for the Predictive Infrastructure Maintenance Platform.
Form a cross-functional 'Data Governance' task force to begin mapping data silos and selecting technical stack for the radical Data Exchange project.

key_weaknesses: High dependency on a single decision-maker (founder) leading to potential bottlenecks and slow strategic pivots.
Formal innovation process gaps, resulting in reactive 'opportunistic' improvements rather than proactive scaling.
Limited internal technical talent necessitating reliance on expensive outsourced contractors, which limits long-term IP creation.
